# JEF Techno

> JEF Techno / JEF Group is a specialist electrical engineering company focused on the safety and reliability of electrical systems. Founded in 1994, JEF provides engineering consulting, audit services, protection solutions and related products across India and international markets.

Build ID: jef-ai-knowledge-2026-10-08-v2.0.0

## Products
- [JEF Shield](https://www.jeftechno.com/Products/JEF-shield) — Automated lightning protection risk assessment and design tool.
- [CLPS](https://www.jeftechno.com/Products/clps-products) — Lightning protection products/systems.
- [ESE Lightning Protection](https://www.jeftechno.com/Products/ese-lightning-protection) — ESE lightning protection solutions.

## Engineering tools
JEF names ETAP, PSCAD/EMTDC, PSS/E, DIgSILENT, SKM, DSA Tools and CDEGS in its engineering capabilities.
